summary: Super League Enterprise filed an 8-K reporting an increase in its at-the-market (ATM) equity sales program. On September 29, 2026, the Company raised the maximum aggregate offering price under its August 18, 2026 Sales Agreement with agents The Benchmark Company and StoneX Financial by $966,000, to a total of $5,465,000, filing a corresponding prospectus supplement under its December 2024 Form S-3. This is an ordinary shelf takedown increase, not a special situation. The $966,000 incremental capacity represents modest dilution potential; watch ATM utilization pace and share-price pressure from ongoing at-market sales.
